summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence". Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term, and its daily volume jumped from $9M to $67M. New coins followed: another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, and others. None is affiliated with the announcement. Measured: five coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-sapling: Sapling (sapling.cash) is a Zcash-themed launchpad on Solana: coins planted there buy and burn $SAPLING, and burns can be stamped into Zcash shielded notes. Measured: $SAPLING and two coins whose metadata says they launched on Sapling, across all pools.
summaries.n-x-money: UsePaid routes each coin's creator fees to the X account it is launched for. Measured: 17 coins that name their recipient, across all pools; it does not measure payouts or recipient endorsement.
summaries.n-pair-rewards: StonkFun reward coins turn transfer tax into distributions of the paired asset. Measured: ZCAT (paid in ZEC) and KNOTS (paid in STONK) across all pools; the quote assets are excluded.
summaries.n-launchpad-coins: Coins for new launch tools, several copying the UsePaid model for other platforms, plus launchpads such as Curve, LesGo and ZIP that issued their own coin. Measured across all pools; it does not measure platform usage.

n-super-intelligence.notice: Trump: "We're going to be renaming it super intelligence, officially renaming it."
n-super-intelligence.interpretation: Multiple news accounts report the 2026-09-29 White House remarks; whether a signed document exists was not verified. The coins trade on the headline only.
